api_host.description: Configure host for API endpoint. Defaults to the host itself.
api_host.name: api_host

api_protocol.description: What protocol to use to access the API endpoint. Supported values: 'http', 'https'.
api_protocol.name: api_protocol

artifact_registry_domains.description:
The domains of associated Artifact Registries. These are used to configure the
Docker credential helper. Only list a domain here if it is actually backed by
GitLab Artifact Registry: the credential helper tries this key first, and a
successful token exchange is used as-is, with no fallback to
container_registry_domains. A container-registry domain listed here by mistake
gets an artifact-registry token the registry rejects, and 'docker pull' hard-fails.
artifact_registry_domains.name: artifact_registry_domains

branch_prefix.description:
Prefix used by 'glab stack' when naming generated branches. Defaults to the
current user's username (from 'os/user.Current'), falling back to 'glab-stack' if unavailable.
branch_prefix.name: branch_prefix

browser.description: What browser glab should run when opening links. This global config cannot be overridden by hostname.
browser.name: browser

ca_cert.description:
Path to a CA certificate (PEM) used to verify the GitLab server's
TLS certificate. Useful for self-signed or private certificate authorities.
ca_cert.name: ca_cert

check_update.description:
Allow glab to automatically check for updates and notify you when there are new updates.
Setting the environment variable to true also forces a check, bypassing the once-a-day interval.
check_update.name: check_update

client_cert.description: Path to a client certificate (PEM) used for mutual TLS authentication.
client_cert.name: client_cert

client_id.description:
OAuth application client ID. Required when authenticating with OAuth
against a self-managed GitLab instance.
client_id.name: client_id

client_key.description: Path to the private key (PEM) that matches client_cert.
client_key.name: client_key

container_registry_domains.description:
The domains of associated container registries. These are used to configure the
Docker credential helper.
container_registry_domains.name: container_registry_domains

custom_headers.description:
Custom HTTP headers to add to all HTTP requests made by glab. Each header must use exactly one of value, valueFromEnv, or valueFromCommand. A command must print the complete header value on one line. glab runs it once for each process.
- name: Proxy-Authorization
  valueFromCommand: token-helper --audience example
- name: Cf-Access-Client-Secret
  valueFromEnv: MY_SECRET_VALUE
custom_headers.name: custom_headers

debug.description: Output more logging information, including underlying Git commands, expanded aliases, and DNS error details.
debug.name: debug

display_hyperlinks.description: Whether or not to display hyperlinks in terminal output. Defaults to true (enabled for TTYs). Set to false to disable. Force hyperlinks in non-TTY environments by setting FORCE_HYPERLINKS=1.
display_hyperlinks.name: display_hyperlinks

duo_cli_auto_download.description: Automatically download Duo CLI binary without prompting (true/false).
duo_cli_auto_download.name: duo_cli_auto_download

duo_cli_auto_run.description: Automatically run GitLab Duo CLI without prompting (true/false). Set to true to skip the confirmation prompt.
duo_cli_auto_run.name: duo_cli_auto_run

duo_cli_binary_checksum.description: SHA256 checksum of the installed Duo CLI binary (automatically set).
duo_cli_binary_checksum.name: duo_cli_binary_checksum

duo_cli_binary_path.description: Path to the installed Duo CLI binary (automatically set). Default: ~/.config/glab-cli/bin/duo
duo_cli_binary_path.name: duo_cli_binary_path

duo_cli_binary_version.description: Version of the installed Duo CLI binary (automatically set).
duo_cli_binary_version.name: duo_cli_binary_version

duo_cli_last_update_check.description: Last time an update check was performed (automatically set).
duo_cli_last_update_check.name: duo_cli_last_update_check

editor.description: What editor glab should run when creating issues, merge requests, etc. This global config cannot be overridden by hostname.
editor.name: editor

git_protocol.description: What protocol to use when performing Git operations. Supported values: 'ssh', 'https'.
git_protocol.name: git_protocol

glab_pager.description: Your desired pager command to use, such as 'less -R'. Takes precedence over the PAGER environment variable. GLAB_PAGER takes precedence over both.
glab_pager.name: glab_pager

glamour_style.description: Set your desired Markdown renderer style. Available options are [dark, light, notty]. To set a custom style, refer to https://github.com/charmbracelet/glamour#styles
glamour_style.name: glamour_style

is_oauth2.description: CLI-managed flag indicating the host was authenticated via OAuth.
is_oauth2.name: is_oauth2

job_token.description:
CI job token used for Job-Token authentication. Typically populated
automatically from CI_JOB_TOKEN when CI auto-login is enabled.
job_token.name: job_token

last_seen_version.description: Last glab version a post-upgrade banner was shown for (automatically set).
last_seen_version.name: last_seen_version

last_update_check_timestamp.description: Last update check timestamp, used for checking when the last update check was performed.
last_update_check_timestamp.name: last_update_check_timestamp

last_whatsnew_version.description: Last glab version 'glab whatsnew' rendered notes for (automatically set).
last_whatsnew_version.name: last_whatsnew_version

no_prompt.description: Set to true (1) to disable prompts, or false (0) to enable them.
no_prompt.name: no_prompt

notify_skill_updates.description: Show a notice when an installed agent skill (bundled or remote) has updates available.
notify_skill_updates.name: notify_skill_updates

oauth2_refresh_token.description: CLI-managed OAuth refresh token. Written by 'glab auth login'.
oauth2_refresh_token.name: oauth2_refresh_token

orbit_cli_auto_download.description: Automatically download the GitLab Orbit CLI binary without prompting (true/false).
orbit_cli_auto_download.name: orbit_cli_auto_download

orbit_cli_auto_run.description: Automatically run the GitLab Orbit CLI without prompting (true/false). Set to true to skip the confirmation prompt.
orbit_cli_auto_run.name: orbit_cli_auto_run

orbit_cli_binary_checksum.description: SHA256 checksum of the installed GitLab Orbit CLI binary (automatically set).
orbit_cli_binary_checksum.name: orbit_cli_binary_checksum

orbit_cli_binary_path.description: Path to the installed GitLab Orbit CLI binary (automatically set). Default: ~/.config/glab-cli/bin/orbit
orbit_cli_binary_path.name: orbit_cli_binary_path

orbit_cli_binary_version.description: Version of the installed GitLab Orbit CLI binary (automatically set).
orbit_cli_binary_version.name: orbit_cli_binary_version

orbit_cli_last_update_check.description: Last time a GitLab Orbit CLI update check was performed (automatically set).
orbit_cli_last_update_check.name: orbit_cli_last_update_check

proxy.description: Custom proxy for this host. Overrides environment proxy settings when set.
proxy.name: proxy

refresh_token.description: CLI-managed refresh token; superseded by oauth2_refresh_token.
refresh_token.name: refresh_token

remote_alias.description:
Name of the 'git remote' that points at the GitLab repository. Used to
resolve which remote to operate against when multiple are configured.
remote_alias.name: remote_alias

show_whats_new.description: Show a one-time post-upgrade banner pointing at 'glab whatsnew' when a new version is detected.
show_whats_new.name: show_whats_new

skip_tls_verify.description:
Skip TLS certificate verification when talking to this host (true/false).
Empty is treated as false. Use only for development; do not enable in production.
skip_tls_verify.name: skip_tls_verify

ssh_host.description:
Alternate hostname for SSH Git operations (e.g., 'ssh.example.com' or 'git.example.com').
Use this when SSH uses a different hostname than HTTP/API operations.
Only affects SSH cloning and Git operations.
ssh_host.name: ssh_host

subfolder.description:
Subfolder where GitLab is installed (e.g., 'gitlab' for https://example.com/gitlab/).
Use this when GitLab is hosted at a subfolder rather than domain root.
Supports nested paths (e.g., 'apps/gitlab' for https://example.com/apps/gitlab/).
Slashes are automatically trimmed, so 'gitlab', '/gitlab', and 'gitlab/' are equivalent.
Only applies to HTTP/HTTPS operations (API and Git clone).
subfolder.name: subfolder

telemetry.description:
Set to false (0) to disable sending usage data to your GitLab instance or true (1) to enable.
See https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/usage_statistics/
for more information
telemetry.name: telemetry

token.description: Your GitLab access token. To get one, read https://docs.gitlab.com/user/profile/personal_access_tokens/
token.name: token

use_keyring.description:
Store the host's credentials in the operating system's keyring (true/false).
Set automatically by 'glab auth login', which defaults to 'true' when a keyring
backend is available. Empty is treated as false (plaintext file storage).
use_keyring.name: use_keyring

user.description: Username associated with the configured token. Set automatically on login.
user.name: user
